compiled_state.title: GREEN: update merge-to-main-pr.sh to accept STORY_PR_BASE for story sub-branch PRs
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Testing Mode: GREEN

## What
Update plugins/dso/scripts/merge-to-main-pr.sh to honor a STORY_PR_BASE env var in _phase_merge. When STORY_PR_BASE is set and non-empty, pass --base "$STORY_PR_BASE" to gh pr create instead of --base main. When unset or empty, default to main (backward compat).

## Why
In sprint Phase F ci-pr mode, story/* PRs must target the session branch (e.g., worktree-20260515-200444) so story merges flow into the session PR rather than bypassing it to main. The SESSION_BRANCH is resolved by the SKILL.md orchestrator (via resolve-session-branch.sh) and injected as STORY_PR_BASE before calling merge-to-main.sh.

## Implementation constraints
- Change is limited to _phase_merge (the gh pr create call site at line ~449).
- Add a local _pr_base variable: `local _pr_base="${STORY_PR_BASE:-main}"`.
- Replace `--base main` with `--base "$_pr_base"` in both the primary gh pr create call and the duplicate-PR detection query (gh pr list --base filter).
- The duplicate draft PR reuse logic checks for existing open PRs — the base filter should also use _pr_base so it doesn't reuse a session→main draft as a story→session draft.
- Do NOT change the session draft PR creation path (create-sprint-draft-pr.sh) — that is Session Phase A and not part of this story.

## Acceptance
All 3 tests from task T1 (RED) now pass GREEN after this change.

## File impact
- plugins/dso/scripts/merge-to-main-pr.sh (modify _phase_merge)
